purpose: Native integration evidence only; generated YAML is illustrative and not a second production registry.
money_mapping: SLayer DataType.DOUBLE is its numeric category; Column.db_type='DECIMAL(18,2)' preserves native exact aggregate values. JSON money amounts are tested as decimal strings; ratios remain floating point.
local_filter_lowering: ast.unparse of literal tuple; iif(predicate, value, None); no variables and no global fact/category predicates
time_alignment_caveat: Population/vehicle ratios are arithmetic period-alignment probes; vehicle observation date is still unspecified. No strict same-snapshot claim.
execution_note: Unmodified native SlayerQueryEngine.execute, with a 50ms event-loop wakeup callback in this probe harness only.

probes.title: Population root: canton population and inverse vehicles

response.sql:
WITH _base AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(population.people) AS "population.probe_people"
  FROM population AS population
  WHERE
    population.report_year = 2025
), _cm_population__vehicles__vehicles_sum AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(vehicles.vehicles) AS "vehicles.vehicles_sum"
  FROM vehicles AS vehicles
  LEFT JOIN population AS population
    ON vehicles.report_year = population.report_year
    AND vehicles.geo_version = population.geo_version
    AND vehicles.municipality_id = population.municipality_id
  WHERE
    population.report_year = 2025
)
SELECT
  _base."population.probe_people",
  _cm_population__vehicles__vehicles_sum."vehicles.vehicles_sum" AS "population.probe_vehicles"
FROM _base
CROSS JOIN _cm_population__vehicles__vehicles_sum

WITH _base AS (
  SELECT
    population.municipality_id AS "population.municipality_id",
    SUM(population.people) AS "population.probe_people"
  FROM population AS population
  WHERE
    population.report_year = 2025
  GROUP BY
    population.municipality_id
), _cm_population__vehicles__vehicles_sum AS (
  SELECT
    vehicles.municipality_id AS "vehicles.municipality_id",
    SUM(vehicles.vehicles) AS "vehicles.vehicles_sum"
  FROM vehicles AS vehicles
  LEFT JOIN population AS population
    ON vehicles.report_year = population.report_year
    AND vehicles.geo_version = population.geo_version
    AND vehicles.municipality_id = population.municipality_id
  WHERE
    population.report_year = 2025
  GROUP BY
    vehicles.municipality_id
)
SELECT
  _base."population.municipality_id",
  _base."population.probe_people",
  _cm_population__vehicles__vehicles_sum."vehicles.vehicles_sum" AS "population.probe_vehicles"
FROM _base
LEFT JOIN _cm_population__vehicles__vehicles_sum
  ON _base."population.municipality_id" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_population__vehicles__vehicles_sum."vehicles.municipality_id"
ORDER BY
  _base."population.municipality_id" ASC

probes.title: All ten districts through municipality relation

WITH _base AS (
  SELECT
    municipalities.district_name AS "population.municipalities.district_name",
    SUM(population.people) AS "population.probe_people"
  FROM population AS population
  LEFT JOIN municipalities AS municipalities
    ON population.geo_version = municipalities.geo_version
    AND population.municipality_id = municipalities.municipality_id
  WHERE
    population.report_year = 2025
  GROUP BY
    municipalities.district_name
), _cm_population__vehicles__vehicles_sum AS (
  SELECT
    population__municipalities.district_name AS "vehicles.population.municipalities.district_name",

  LEFT JOIN population AS population
    ON vehicles.report_year = population.report_year
    AND vehicles.geo_version = population.geo_version
    AND vehicles.municipality_id = population.municipality_id
  LEFT JOIN municipalities AS population__municipalities
    ON population.geo_version = population__municipalities.geo_version
    AND population.municipality_id = population__municipalities.municipality_id
  WHERE
    population.report_year = 2025
  GROUP BY
    population__municipalities.district_name
)
SELECT
  _base."population.municipalities.district_name",
  _base."population.probe_people",
  _cm_population__vehicles__vehicles_sum."vehicles.vehicles_sum" AS "population.probe_vehicles"

  ON _base."population.municipalities.district_name" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_population__vehicles__vehicles_sum."vehicles.population.municipalities.district_name"
ORDER BY

    AND population.municipality_id = vehicles.municipality_id

), _cm_population__people_sum_partition_by AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(population.people) AS "population.probe_reference_people"
  FROM population AS population
  WHERE
    population.report_year = 2025
), _cm_population__vehicles__vehicles_sum AS (

)
SELECT
  _base."population.vehicles.vehicle_category_code",
  _cm_population__vehicles__vehicles_sum."vehicles.vehicles_sum" AS "population.probe_vehicles",
  _cm_population__people_sum_partition_by."population.probe_reference_people",

probes.title: Years root: inverse staff and revenue at annual grain

response.sql:
WITH _base AS (
  SELECT
    years.report_year AS "years.report_year"
  FROM years AS years
  WHERE
    years.report_year IN (2024, 2025)
  GROUP BY
    years.report_year
), _cm_years__staff__staff_sum AS (
  SELECT
    staff.report_year AS "staff.report_year",
    SUM(staff.staff) AS "staff.staff_sum"
  FROM staff AS staff
  LEFT JOIN years AS years
    ON staff.report_year = years.report_year
  WHERE
    years.report_year IN (2024, 2025)
  GROUP BY
    staff.report_year
), _cm_years__revenue__nominal_chf_sum AS (
  SELECT
    revenue.report_year AS "revenue.report_year",
    SUM(revenue.nominal_chf) AS "revenue.nominal_chf_sum"
  FROM revenue AS revenue
  LEFT JOIN years AS years
    ON revenue.report_year = years.report_year
  WHERE
    years.report_year IN (2024, 2025)
  GROUP BY
    revenue.report_year
)
SELECT
  _base."years.report_year",
  _cm_years__staff__staff_sum."staff.staff_sum" AS "years.probe_staff",
  _cm_years__revenue__nominal_chf_sum."revenue.nominal_chf_sum" AS "years.probe_revenue",
  _cm_years__revenue__nominal_chf_sum."revenue.nominal_chf_sum" / NULLIF(NULLIF(_cm_years__staff__staff_sum."staff.staff_sum", 0), 0) AS "years.probe_per_person"
FROM _base
LEFT JOIN _cm_years__staff__staff_sum
  ON _base."years.report_year" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_years__staff__staff_sum."staff.report_year"
LEFT JOIN _cm_years__revenue__nominal_chf_sum
  ON _base."years.report_year" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_years__revenue__nominal_chf_sum."revenue.report_year"
ORDER BY
  _base."years.report_year" ASC

WITH _base AS (
  SELECT
    1 AS _placeholder
  FROM years AS years
  WHERE
    years.report_year IN (2024, 2025)
  LIMIT 1
), _base_2 AS (
  SELECT
    years.report_year AS "years.report_year"
  FROM years AS years
  WHERE
    years.report_year IN (2024, 2025)
  GROUP BY
    years.report_year
), _cm_years__staff__staff_sum_partition_by_report_year AS (
  SELECT
    staff.report_year AS "staff.report_year",
    SUM(staff.staff) AS "staff.staff_sum_partition_by_years_report_year"
  FROM staff AS staff
  LEFT JOIN years AS years
    ON staff.report_year = years.report_year
  WHERE
    years.report_year IN (2024, 2025)
  GROUP BY
    staff.report_year
), _cm_staff__staff_sum_partition_by_report_year AS (
  SELECT
    _stage_inner."years.report_year" AS "report_year",
    _stage_inner."years.staff.staff_sum_partition_by_report_year" AS "staff__staff_sum_partition_by_report_year"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      _base_2."years.report_year",
      _cm_years__staff__staff_sum_partition_by_report_year."staff.staff_sum_partition_by_years_report_year" AS "years.staff.staff_sum_partition_by_report_year"
    FROM _base_2
    LEFT JOIN _cm_years__staff__staff_sum_partition_by_report_year
      ON _base_2."years.report_year" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_years__staff__staff_sum_partition_by_report_year."staff.report_year"
  ) AS _stage_inner
), _cm_years___avg AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(AVG(_base._v) AS DOUBLE) AS "years.probe_mean_annual_staff"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      years.report_year AS _ek0,
      MAX(
        _cm_staff__staff_sum_partition_by_report_year."staff__staff_sum_partition_by_report_year"
      ) AS _v
    FROM years AS years
    LEFT JOIN _cm_staff__staff_sum_partition_by_report_year
      ON years.report_year IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_staff__staff_sum_partition_by_report_year."report_year"
    WHERE
      years.report_year IN (2024, 2025)
    GROUP BY
      years.report_year
  ) AS _base
)
SELECT
  _cm_years___avg."years.probe_mean_annual_staff"
FROM _base
CROSS JOIN _cm_years___avg

WITH _base AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', years.period_start) AS "years.period_start"
  FROM years AS years
  WHERE
    (
      years.period_start >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE)
      AND years.period_start < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
    )
  GROUP BY
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', years.period_start)
), _cm_years__revenue__nominal_chf_sum AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', years.period_start) AS "revenue.years.period_start",
    SUM(revenue.nominal_chf) AS "revenue.nominal_chf_sum"
  FROM revenue AS revenue
  LEFT JOIN years AS years
    ON revenue.report_year = years.report_year
  WHERE
    years.period_start >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE)
    AND years.period_start < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
  GROUP BY
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', years.period_start)
), base AS (
  SELECT
    _base."years.period_start",
    _cm_years__revenue__nominal_chf_sum."revenue.nominal_chf_sum" AS "years.probe_current"
  FROM _base
  LEFT JOIN _cm_years__revenue__nominal_chf_sum
    ON _base."years.period_start" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_years__revenue__nominal_chf_sum."revenue.years.period_start"
), _base_2 AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', years.period_start) AS "years.period_start"
  FROM years AS years
  GROUP BY
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', years.period_start)
), _cm_years__revenue__nominal_chf_sum_2 AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', years.period_start) AS "revenue.years.period_start",
    SUM(revenue.nominal_chf) AS "revenue.nominal_chf_sum"
  FROM revenue AS revenue
  LEFT JOIN years AS years
    ON revenue.report_year = years.report_year
  GROUP BY
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', years.period_start)
), shifted_probe_previous AS (
  SELECT
    _base_2."years.period_start",
    _cm_years__revenue__nominal_chf_sum_2."revenue.nominal_chf_sum" AS "years.probe_current"
  FROM _base_2
  LEFT JOIN _cm_years__revenue__nominal_chf_sum_2
    ON _base_2."years.period_start" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_years__revenue__nominal_chf_sum_2."revenue.years.period_start"
), sjoin_probe_previous AS (
  SELECT
    base."years.period_start",
    base."years.probe_current",
    shifted_probe_previous."years.probe_current" AS "years.probe_previous"
  FROM base
  LEFT JOIN shifted_probe_previous
    ON base."years.period_start" - INTERVAL 1 YEAR IS NOT DISTINCT FROM shifted_probe_previous."years.period_start"
), step1 AS (
  SELECT
    "years.period_start",
    "years.probe_current",
    "years.probe_previous",
    (
      "years.probe_current" / NULLIF(NULLIF("years.probe_previous", 0), 0) - 1
    ) * 100 AS "years.probe_growth_pct"
  FROM sjoin_probe_previous
)
SELECT
  "years.period_start",
  "years.probe_current",
  "years.probe_previous",
  "years.probe_growth_pct"
FROM (
  SELECT
    "years.period_start",
    "years.probe_current",
    "years.probe_previous",
    "years.probe_growth_pct"
  FROM step1
) AS _outer
ORDER BY
  "years.period_start" ASC

WITH _base AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', years.period_start) AS "years.period_start"
  FROM years AS years
  WHERE
    (
      years.period_start >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE)
      AND years.period_start < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
    )
  GROUP BY
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', years.period_start)
), _cm_years__revenue__nominal_chf_sum AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', years.period_start) AS "revenue.years.period_start",
    SUM(revenue.nominal_chf) AS "revenue.nominal_chf_sum"
  FROM revenue AS revenue
  LEFT JOIN years AS years
    ON revenue.report_year = years.report_year
  WHERE
    years.period_start >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE)
    AND years.period_start < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
  GROUP BY
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', years.period_start)
), _cm_years__staff__staff_sum AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', years.period_start) AS "staff.years.period_start",
    SUM(staff.staff) AS "staff.staff_sum"
  FROM staff AS staff
  LEFT JOIN years AS years
    ON staff.report_year = years.report_year
  WHERE
    years.period_start >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE)
    AND years.period_start < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
  GROUP BY
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', years.period_start)
), base AS (
  SELECT
    _base."years.period_start",
    _cm_years__revenue__nominal_chf_sum."revenue.nominal_chf_sum" / NULLIF(NULLIF(_cm_years__staff__staff_sum."staff.staff_sum", 0), 0) AS "years.probe_current",
    _cm_years__revenue__nominal_chf_sum."revenue.nominal_chf_sum" AS "revenue.nominal_chf_sum",
    _cm_years__staff__staff_sum."staff.staff_sum" AS "staff.staff_sum"
  FROM _base
  LEFT JOIN _cm_years__revenue__nominal_chf_sum
    ON _base."years.period_start" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_years__revenue__nominal_chf_sum."revenue.years.period_start"
  LEFT JOIN _cm_years__staff__staff_sum
    ON _base."years.period_start" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_years__staff__staff_sum."staff.years.period_start"
), shifted_probe_previous AS (
  SELECT
    "years.period_start" AS "years.period_start",
    "years.probe_current" AS "years.probe_current"
  FROM base
), sjoin_probe_previous AS (
  SELECT
    base."years.period_start",
    base."years.probe_current",
    base."revenue.nominal_chf_sum",
    base."staff.staff_sum",
    shifted_probe_previous."years.probe_current" AS "years.probe_previous"
  FROM base
  LEFT JOIN shifted_probe_previous
    ON base."years.period_start" - INTERVAL 1 YEAR IS NOT DISTINCT FROM shifted_probe_previous."years.period_start"
), step1 AS (
  SELECT
    "years.period_start",
    "years.probe_current",
    "revenue.nominal_chf_sum",
    "staff.staff_sum",
    "years.probe_previous",
    (
      "years.probe_current" / NULLIF(NULLIF("years.probe_previous", 0), 0) - 1
    ) * 100 AS "years.probe_growth_pct"
  FROM sjoin_probe_previous
)
SELECT
  "years.period_start",
  "years.probe_current",
  "years.probe_previous",
  "years.probe_growth_pct"
FROM (
  SELECT
    "years.period_start",
    "years.probe_current",
    "revenue.nominal_chf_sum",
    "staff.staff_sum",
    "years.probe_previous",
    "years.probe_growth_pct"
  FROM step1
) AS _outer
ORDER BY
  "years.period_start" ASC
